words.example: Allocate one clerk to the overdue invoices.
words.exampleZh: 派一名職員處理逾期發票。
words.notes: allocate sth to sb 是把某物分配給某人。

words.example: Apparently the tax line was left off.
words.exampleZh: 稅額那一行顯然被漏了。
words.notes: 看起來、顯然。

words.example: Payment needs approval from the manager.
words.exampleZh: 付款要經理批准。
words.notes: 贊成、同意、批准。approval of 是對某事的批准。

words.example: The manager will approve the credit note.
words.exampleZh: 經理會批准這張折讓單。
words.notes: approve of 是贊成。approve sth 是批准某事。

words.example: The brokerage is two percent.
words.exampleZh: 經紀佣金是百分之二。
words.notes: 經紀業務，或付給經紀人的佣金。

words.example: The certificate must travel with the invoice.
words.exampleZh: 證明文件要和發票一起走。
words.notes: 證明書。

words.example: Clearance of the cheque takes two days.
words.exampleZh: 這張支票結清要兩天。
words.notes: 結算、清票，也可指通關。

words.example: The dates on the two invoices are not coherent.
words.exampleZh: 兩張發票上的日期對不上。
words.notes: 連貫的、一致的。

words.example: Combine the two bills into one payment.
words.exampleZh: 兩張帳單合併成一次付款。
words.notes: combine A with B 是把兩者合在一起。

words.example: The combination of tax and freight confused them.
words.exampleZh: 稅和運費加在一起，他們看糊塗了。
words.notes: 結合、組合。in combination with 是與某物一起。

words.example: The commission is due when the client pays.
words.exampleZh: 客戶付款時，佣金才到期。
words.notes: 佣金、提成。commission on 是某筆交易的佣金。

words.example: One concession is a longer payment term.
words.exampleZh: 其中一項讓步是把付款期限拉長。
words.notes: 讓步。make a concession 是做出讓步。

words.example: Wait for confirmation before you ship.
words.exampleZh: 出貨前先等確認。
words.notes: 確認、證實。confirmation of 是對某事的確認。

words.example: Similar invoice numbers confuse the clerk.
words.exampleZh: 發票號碼太像，職員會搞混。
words.notes: confuse A with B 是把甲和乙混淆。

words.example: A missing stamp has a real consequence.
words.exampleZh: 漏蓋章會有實際後果。
words.notes: 結果、後果。as a consequence 是因此。

words.example: The total was wrong; consequently the cheque bounced.
words.exampleZh: 總額錯了，因此支票被退票。
words.notes: 所以、結果。

words.example: Personal consumption is not on this invoice.
words.exampleZh: 個人消費不開在這張發票上。
words.notes: 消費、消耗。consumption of 是對某物的消耗。

words.example: Check the content of the receipt.
words.exampleZh: 核對收據上的內容。
words.notes: 名詞是內容，複數 contents 常指所裝的東西。形容詞是滿意的，be content with。動詞是使滿足。

words.example: On the contrary, the invoice was already paid.
words.exampleZh: 正好相反，這張發票已經付過了。
words.notes: on the contrary 是恰恰相反。contrary to 是與某事相反。也可作副詞。

words.example: By convention, the invoice follows the goods.
words.exampleZh: 依照慣例，發票隨貨。
words.notes: 習俗、慣例，也可指大會或約定。

words.example: The conversation about the bill stayed polite.
words.exampleZh: 談這張帳單時，語氣一直客氣。
words.notes: 談話。可數或不可數。

words.example: Convertibility of the credit into cash is limited.
words.exampleZh: 這筆貸項換成現金的程度有限。
words.notes: 可以兌換的性質。

words.example: A corrupt total will not pass the audit.
words.exampleZh: 總額被做過手腳，稽核過不了。
words.notes: 形容詞是腐敗的、不正確的。動詞是使腐敗，或破壞資料。

words.example: The audit found no corruption in the payments.
words.exampleZh: 稽核沒有發現付款裡有貪污。
words.notes: 貪污、腐敗，或資料損毀。

words.example: A revised total hurts credibility.
words.exampleZh: 總額一改，可信度就受損。
words.notes: 可信性、可靠性。

words.example: The explanation is credible.
words.exampleZh: 這個解釋可信。
words.notes: 可信的、可靠的。

words.example: The creditor signed at the bottom.
words.exampleZh: 債權人在下方簽名。
words.notes: 債權人、貸方。debtor 是債務人。

words.example: The tax number is crucial.
words.exampleZh: 統一編號很關鍵。
words.notes: 重要的、決定性的。be crucial to 是對某事很重要。

words.example: It is a delusion that the bill was cancelled.
words.exampleZh: 以為帳單已取消，是錯覺。
words.notes: 迷惑、錯覺、幻想。

words.example: The balance will descend after this payment.
words.exampleZh: 這筆付款之後，餘額會下降。
words.notes: 下降、下來。descend from 是起源於。

words.example: Late fees diminish what the supplier receives.
words.exampleZh: 滯納金會讓供應商實收變少。
words.notes: 使變少。diminish by 是減少某個幅度。

words.example: Discard the draft once the original is filed.
words.exampleZh: 正本歸檔後，草稿就可以丟。
words.notes: 拋棄、丟棄。也可作名詞。

words.example: He will disclaim any knowledge of the duplicate.
words.exampleZh: 他會否認知道有這份副本。
words.notes: 否認、拒絕承認。disclaim responsibility 是拒負責任。

words.example: The contract can dispense with a paper copy.
words.exampleZh: 合約可以免去紙本。
words.notes: dispense with 是免掉、無需。也可指分配。

words.example: Stamp the document before you file it.
words.exampleZh: 歸檔前先在文件上蓋章。
words.notes: 單據、文件。

words.example: The documentation does not match the invoice.
words.exampleZh: 證明文件和發票不一致。
words.notes: 一套文件或記錄。

words.example: The draft is payable in thirty days.
words.exampleZh: 這張匯票三十天後到期。
words.notes: 名詞是匯票，也可指草稿。動詞是起草。

words.example: The drawer of the bill must sign.
words.exampleZh: 匯票的開票人必須簽名。
words.notes: 開票人。另一個意思是抽屜。

words.example: The balance is due on Friday.
words.exampleZh: 餘額星期五到期。
words.notes: 到期的、應付的。due to 是由於。due to do 是預定做某事。

words.example: Do not duplicate the invoice number.
words.exampleZh: 不要把發票號碼複製成兩張。
words.notes: 複製、複印。duplicate of 是某物的副本。

words.example: Duplication of the invoice caused a double charge.
words.exampleZh: 發票被複製，結果收了兩次錢。
words.notes: 複製這個行為，或一份副本。

words.example: She gave an earnest warning about the due date.
words.exampleZh: 她認真提醒到期日。
words.notes: 認真的、誠摯的。in earnest 是認真地。也可作名詞。

words.example: The tax line is a required element.
words.exampleZh: 稅額那一行是必要項目。
words.notes: 元素、要素。an element of 是有一點某性質。

words.example: A second charge emerged after the audit.
words.exampleZh: 稽核之後又出現一筆費用。
words.notes: 出現、形成。emerge from 是從某處出現。

words.example: The stamped copy is evidence of payment.
words.exampleZh: 蓋過章的那份是付款證據。
words.notes: 證據。不可數時指證據整體。evidence of 是某事的證據。

words.example: Factorage is listed under other charges.
words.exampleZh: 代理手續費列在其他費用底下。
words.notes: 代理業務的手續費。

words.example: He began to falter when asked about the total.
words.exampleZh: 一問到總額，他就支吾起來。
words.notes: 說話遲疑，或步伐不穩。

words.example: A haze of corrections covers the total.
words.exampleZh: 總額上塗改得一片模糊。
words.notes: 薄霧，或看不清楚的狀態。

words.example: The bank will honor the draft on Friday.
words.exampleZh: 銀行星期五會兌付這張匯票。
words.notes: 美式拼法。兌付票據，也可指尊敬。英式常作 honour。

words.example: The two copies are identical.
words.exampleZh: 兩份副本完全相同。
words.notes: identical to 或 identical with 是與某物相同。

words.example: Pay immediately if the stamp is missing.
words.exampleZh: 如果漏了章，就立刻處理付款。
words.notes: 立即、馬上。

words.example: The supplier grew impatient about the delay.
words.exampleZh: 貨款拖著，供應商不耐煩了。
words.notes: 焦躁的。impatient with 是對某人不耐煩。impatient to do 是急著做某事。

words.example: The deposit is inadequate.
words.exampleZh: 這筆訂金不夠。
words.notes: 不充分的、不能勝任的。inadequate for 是對某用途不足。

words.example: A late fee is inevitable after the tenth.
words.exampleZh: 十號以後，滯納金就免不了。
words.notes: 必然的、無法避免的。

words.example: Send the invoice with the goods.
words.exampleZh: 發票隨貨送出。
words.notes: 名詞是發票。動詞是開立發票。invoice sb for 是為某物向某人開立發票。

words.example: A kickback is not an allowed discount.
words.exampleZh: 回扣不是允許的折扣。
words.notes: 回扣。另一個意思是強烈的反彈。

words.example: The manifest lists every package.
words.exampleZh: 艙單列出每一件包裹。
words.notes: 名詞是艙單、載貨清單。動詞是顯示、表明。

words.example: A rounded total can be misleading.
words.exampleZh: 四捨五入的總額可能誤導人。
words.notes: 令人誤解的。

words.example: The mistaken total was corrected.
words.exampleZh: 錯誤的總額已經改過。
words.notes: 弄錯的。be mistaken about 是對某事有誤解。

words.example: The omission was the buyer's tax number.
words.exampleZh: 漏掉的是買方的統一編號。
words.notes: 省略、遺漏。omission of 是漏掉某物。

words.example: Do not omit the due date.
words.exampleZh: 不要漏掉到期日。
words.notes: 刪掉或遺漏。過去式 omitted 會重複 t。

words.example: The on-going review covers March invoices.
words.exampleZh: 持續進行的覆核包含三月的發票。
words.notes: 中間有連字號。正在進行的。也常寫成 ongoing，一個字。

words.example: Keep the original in the file.
words.exampleZh: 正本留在檔案裡。
words.notes: 名詞是原件。形容詞是原始的。

words.example: The payee name must match the account.
words.exampleZh: 收款人姓名要和帳戶一致。
words.notes: 收款人。payer 是付款人。

words.example: A photocopy is not enough for the bank.
words.exampleZh: 銀行不接受只有影印本。
words.notes: 影印。photocopy paper 是影印紙。

words.example: The receipt will be ready presently.
words.exampleZh: 收據不久就好。
words.notes: 不久，也可指目前。

words.example: Ask for a receipt when you pay.
words.exampleZh: 付款時請對方開收據。
words.notes: 名詞是收據，或收到。動詞是承認收到。

words.example: Remind the client that the draft is due.
words.exampleZh: 提醒客戶匯票要到期了。
words.notes: remind sb of 是使某人想起。remind sb to do 是提醒某人做某事。

words.example: The draft is payable at sight.
words.exampleZh: 這張匯票見票即付。
words.notes: at sight 是見票即付。名詞也可指視力。形容詞是見票即付的。

words.example: The credit line is terminable on ten days' notice.
words.exampleZh: 這條信用額度可在十天通知後終止。
words.notes: 有期限的、可以終止的。

words.example: The clerk can testify that the stamp is genuine.
words.exampleZh: 這名職員可以證明印章是真的。
words.notes: 作證、證明。testify to 是證明某事。testify that 是作證說。

words.example: File the triplicate with the bank copy.
words.exampleZh: 第三聯和銀行那份放在一起。
words.notes: 一式三份，或其中的第三份。in triplicate 是一式三份地。

words.example: Payment terms vary by client.
words.exampleZh: 付款條件因客戶而異。
words.notes: 變化、改變。vary in 是在某方面不同。vary from 是與某物不同。

words.example: The waybill number is on the invoice.
words.exampleZh: 運單號碼寫在發票上。
words.notes: 貨運單，也可指乘客名單。air waybill 是空運提單。
